title: Constellation Energy: Power for AI

beats.text: Every AI datacenter needs electricity. Constellation Energy (CEG) supplies it.
CEG trades at $251.38. A fundamental-value model puts fair value at $274.56, as of July 11.
The model calls it fairly valued, close to market price. No signal to buy or sell.
